alt: The program reads several edge checks. Each gives the discovery and finish times of the edge's two ends at the moment the search tries it, with -1 meaning no time yet. It prints tree when the far end has no discovery time, back when it has one but no finish time, forward when it is finished and was discovered later than the near end, and cross otherwise.
